simple.meaning: מְרֵרָה (mᵉrêrâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “bile (from its bitterness).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְרֵרָה (H4845) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מְרֵרָה (H4845) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מְרֵרָה (mᵉrêrâh) / H4845 is traced through Job 16:13 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4845. mererah [ מְרֵרָה ] noun feminine gall ; only suffix מְרֵרָתִי לָאָרֶץ יִשְׁמֹּךְ Job 16:13 he poureth on the ground my gall (|| כִּלְיוֺתַי יְפַלַּח ), figurative of God's cruel treatment (compare מְרֹרָה 20:25 ).
